articles.title_en: Learning in Repeated Interactions on Networks
articles.title_cn: 网络重复互动中的学习
articles.abstract_en: We study how long‐lived, rational agents learn in a social network. In every period, after observing the past actions of his neighbors, each agent receives a private signal, and chooses an action whose payoff depends only on the state. Since equilibrium actions depend on higher‐order beliefs, it is difficult to characterize behavior. Nevertheless, we show that regardless of the size and shape of the network, the utility function, and the patience of the agents, the speed of learning in any equilibrium is bounded from above by a constant that only depends on the private signal distribution.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究长寿理性的主体如何在社会网络中学习。在每个时期，每个主体在观察到邻居过去的行为后，收到一个私人信号，并选择一个其收益仅取决于状态的行动。由于均衡行动依赖于高阶信念，因此很难刻画行为。尽管如此，我们表明，无论网络的大小和形状、效用函数以及主体的耐心程度如何，任何均衡中的学习速度都受到一个仅取决于私人信号分布的常数的上界限制。

articles.title_en: Drilling Deadlines and Oil and Gas Development
articles.title_cn: 钻井截止日期与油气开发
articles.abstract_en: Oil and gas leases between mineral owners and extraction firms typically specify a date by which the firm must either drill a well or lose the lease. These deadlines are known as primary terms. Using data from the Louisiana shale boom, we first show that well drilling is substantially bunched just before the primary term deadline. This bunching is not necessarily surplus‐reducing: using an estimated model of firms' drilling and input choices, we show that primary terms can increase total surplus by countering the effects of leases' royalties, as royalties are a tax on revenue and delay drilling. These benefits are reduced, however, when production outcomes are sensitive to drilling inputs and when drilling one well indefinitely extends the period of time during which additional wells may be drilled. We enrich the model to consider mineral owners' lease offers and find small effects of primary terms on owners' revenue.
articles.abstract_cn: 矿产所有者与开采公司之间的油气租约通常规定一个日期，届时公司必须钻一口井，否则将失去租约。这些截止日期被称为主要期限。利用路易斯安那州页岩繁荣的数据，我们首先表明，钻井活动大量集中在主要期限截止日期之前。这种集中并不一定减少剩余：通过使用一个估计的公司钻井和投入选择模型，我们表明，主要期限可以通过抵消租约特许权使用费的影响来增加总剩余，因为特许权使用费是对收入的税收，并延迟钻井。然而，当生产结果对钻井投入敏感，并且钻一口井无限期延长了可以钻更多井的时间段时，这些好处会减少。我们丰富了模型以考虑矿产所有者的租约报价，并发现主要期限对所有者收入的影响较小。

articles.title_en: Can Restorative Justice Conferencing Reduce Recidivism? Evidence From the Make‐it‐Right Program
articles.title_cn: 恢复性司法会议能否减少再犯？来自“使之正确”项目的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the effect of a restorative justice intervention targeted at 143 youth ages 13 to 17 facing felony charges of medium severity (e.g., burglary, assault). Eligible youths were randomly assigned to participate in the Make‐it‐Right (MIR) restorative justice program or a control group where they faced standard criminal prosecution. We estimate the effects of MIR on the likelihood that a youth will be rearrested in the four years following randomization. Assignment to MIR reduces the probability of a rearrest within six months by 19 percentage points, a 44 percent reduction relative to the control group. Moreover, the reduction in recidivism persists even four years after randomization. Thus, our estimates show that restorative justice conferencing can reduce recidivism among youth charged with relatively serious offenses and can be an effective alternative to traditional criminal justice practices.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一项针对143名年龄在13至17岁之间、面临中等严重程度重罪指控（如入室盗窃、袭击）的青少年的恢复性司法干预的效果。符合条件的青少年被随机分配到参与“使之正确”（MIR）恢复性司法项目或对照组，后者面临标准的刑事起诉。我们估计了MIR对青少年在随机分组后四年内再次被捕可能性的影响。分配到MIR使六个月内再次被捕的概率降低了19个百分点，相对于对照组减少了44%。此外，即使在随机分组四年后，再犯的减少仍然持续。因此，我们的估计表明，恢复性司法会议可以减少被指控相对严重罪行的青少年的再犯，并且可以成为传统刑事司法实践的有效替代方案。

articles.title_en: Designing Disability Insurance Reforms: Tightening Eligibility Rules or Reducing Benefits?
articles.title_cn: 设计残疾保险改革：收紧资格规则还是减少福利？
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a sufficient statistics framework for analyzing the welfare effects of disability insurance (DI). We derive social‐optimality conditions for the two main DI policy parameters: (i) eligibility rules and (ii) benefit levels. Applying this framework to two restrictive DI reforms in Austria, we find that tighter DI eligibility rules triggered higher fiscal cost savings and lower insurance losses. Hence, tighter DI eligibility rules dominate DI benefit reductions in scaling back the Austrian DI system.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文开发了一个充分统计量框架，用于分析残疾保险（DI）的福利效应。我们推导了DI两个主要政策参数的社会最优条件：（i）资格规则和（ii）福利水平。将该框架应用于奥地利的两次限制性DI改革，我们发现更严格的DI资格规则带来了更高的财政成本节约和更低的保险损失。因此，在缩减奥地利DI体系方面，更严格的DI资格规则优于DI福利削减。

articles.title_en: Do not Blame Bellman: It Is Koopmans' Fault
articles.title_cn: 不要责怪贝尔曼：这是库普曼斯的错
articles.abstract_en: We provide a unified approach to stochastic dynamic programming with recursive utility based on an elementary application of Tarski's fixed point theorem. We establish that the exclusive source of multiple values is the presence of multiple recursive utilities consistent with the given aggregator, each yielding a legitimate value of the recursive program. We also present sufficient conditions ensuring a unique value of the recursive program in some circumstances. Overall, acknowledging the unavoidable failure of uniqueness in general, we argue that the greatest fixed point of the Bellman operator should have a privileged position.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们基于塔斯基不动点定理的一个基本应用，为具有递归效用的随机动态规划提供了一种统一方法。我们确定，多重价值的唯一来源是存在与给定聚合器一致的多个递归效用，每个递归效用都产生递归程序的一个合法价值。我们还提出了在某些情况下确保递归程序具有唯一价值的充分条件。总体而言，承认一般情况下唯一性不可避免的失败，我们认为贝尔曼算子的最大不动点应享有特权地位。

articles.title_en: “Near” Weighted Utilitarian Characterizations of Pareto Optima
articles.title_cn: 帕累托最优的“近似”加权功利主义刻画
articles.abstract_en: We give two characterizations of Pareto optimality via “near” weighted utilitarian welfare maximization. One characterization sequentially maximizes utilitarian welfare functions using a finite sequence of nonnegative and eventually positive welfare weights. The other maximizes a utilitarian welfare function with a certain class of positive hyperreal weights. The social welfare ordering represented by these “near” weighted utilitarian welfare criteria is characterized by the standard axioms for weighted utilitarianism under a suitable weakening of the continuity axiom.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过“近似”加权功利主义福利最大化给出了帕累托最优性的两个刻画。一个刻画使用有限序列的非负且最终为正的福利权重依次最大化功利主义福利函数。另一个刻画使用某类正超实数权重最大化功利主义福利函数。由这些“近似”加权功利主义福利准则所表示的社会福利排序，可通过在适当弱化连续性公理下的标准加权功利主义公理来刻画。

articles.title_en: Comparative Statics With Linear Objectives: Normality, Complementarity, and Ranking Multi‐Prior Beliefs
articles.title_cn: 线性目标下的比较静态分析：正态性、互补性与多先验信念的排序
articles.abstract_en: We formulate an order over constraint sets A⊆Rℓ, called the parallelogram order, which guarantees that argmin{p ⋅ x:x ∈ A} increases in the product order as A increases in the parallelogram order, for any vector p∈Rℓ. Using this result, we characterize the utility/production functions that lead to normal demand as well as the closely related class of production functions with marginal costs that increase with factor prices. By generalizing the concept of supermodularity, we also characterize the class of production functions for which factors are complements. In the context of decision‐making under uncertainty, our new set order leads to natural generalizations of first‐order stochastic dominance in multi‐prior models.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们定义了一种关于约束集A⊆Rℓ的序，称为平行四边形序，该序保证了对于任意向量p∈Rℓ，当A按平行四边形序增大时，argmin{p ⋅ x:x ∈ A}按乘积序增大。利用这一结果，我们刻画了导致正态需求的效用/生产函数，以及与之密切相关的边际成本随要素价格上升而增加的生产函数类别。通过推广超模性的概念，我们还刻画了要素互补的生产函数类别。在不确定性决策的背景下，我们的新集合序导致了多先验模型中一阶随机占优的自然推广。

articles.title_en: Wealth Inequality in a Low Rate Environment
articles.title_cn: 低利率环境下的财富不平等
articles.abstract_en: We study the effect of interest rates on wealth inequality. While lower rates decrease the growth rate of rentiers, they also increase the growth rate of entrepreneurs by making it cheaper to raise capital. To understand which effect dominates, we derive a sufficient statistic for the effect of interest rates on the Pareto exponent of the wealth distribution: it depends on the lifetime equity and debt issuance rate of individuals in the right tail of the wealth distribution. We estimate this sufficient statistic using new data on the trajectory of top fortunes in the U.S. Overall, we find that the secular decline in interest rates (or more generally of required rates of returns) can account for about 40% of the rise in Pareto inequality; that is, the degree to which the super rich pulled ahead relative to the rich.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了利率对财富不平等的影响。虽然较低的利率降低了食利者的增长率，但它们也通过降低融资成本提高了企业家的增长率。为了理解哪种效应占主导地位，我们推导了一个关于利率对财富分布帕累托指数影响的充分统计量：它取决于财富分布右尾个体的一生股权和债务发行率。我们使用关于美国顶级财富轨迹的新数据来估计这一充分统计量。总体而言，我们发现利率（或更一般地，所需回报率）的长期下降可以解释帕累托不平等上升的约40%；也就是说，超级富豪相对于富人领先的程度。

articles.title_cn: 对“预期不确定效用”的评论
